lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs6Sb2 (reduced formula Cs3Sb) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Cs and Sb centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each; the Cs environments include Cs–Sb and Cs–Cs neighbors, while Sb neighbors are surrounded by 12 Cs. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cs-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Cs- and Sb-centered polyhedra.
